children: Overview
US nail-care platform's Q3 net revenue rose 6.1% to $7.7 mln
Operating loss widened to $1.59 mln from $1.26 mln on growth investments
Company acquired Belle Vista Nail Studio for approximately $0.3 mln
Outlook
MiniLuxe expects its approximately 5% price increase to more than offset rising labor and health care benefit costs
Plans to convert its Burlington, Massachusetts studio to the MiniLuxe brand in 2027
Result Drivers
SAME-STUDIO SALES – Net revenue growth was driven by same-studio sales gains in both volume and mix
GROWTH INVESTMENTS – Q3 operating loss widened to $1.59 mln from $1.26 mln, reflecting marketing tests and new studio openings
PARTNER NETWORK – Gross franchise sales rose 53% in Q3 and 102% YTD as MiniLuxe expanded through operating and franchise partners
